note: Cocristallo (±)-PXL1:4-HBA1 in due fasi: Phase I (Pna21, anidra, da LAG) e Phase II (C2/c, solvato con CO2 e acqua nelle cavita', solo da processi con CO2 compressa: GAS e SEDS). I due numeri CCDC (2331588, 2331589) non sono attribuiti alle fasi nel testo. Lo Scheme 2 («The different pathways for switching from one to another phase») e' una figura: il testo non lo descrive e non si estrae. Sovrapposizioni e incoerenze dell'articolo: (1) TGA-MS: i metodi dicono «in the range 20 – 140°C» in argon a 10 °C/min, i risultati «25-130°C» e «from 40 to 110°C»; (2) «the three powders transformed within a few days into Phase I, regardless of the solvent used» contro «after 12 days of storage, the isobutanol sample (IB-40) is still pure at 99% in Phase II» e D+28 = 100 % in Table 3; (3) «complete or almost complete within ten days» (acetone, acetato di etile) contro Table 3 (acetone: 99 % a D+11, 100 % a D+14); (4) SHG: «The solid-solid transformation of Phase I into Phase II was also monitored by second harmonic generation» e la didascalia della Fig. 15 «Quantification of the Phase I -> Phase II by Raman» scrivono I -> II, ma la trasformazione osservata e' II -> I; (5) la risalita del segnale SHG ha onset a ca. 6 giorni e plateau a ca. 20 giorni, mentre la frase di sintesi dice «within ca. 2 weeks»; (6) disidratazione: il DSC la dice dal 20 al 97 °C, la VT-PXRD a 50 °C non vede «any effect of desolvation» (tempi di analisi e atmosfera diversi). Comportamento di desolvatazione e ricristallizzazione dichiarato «similar to that already reported for the (±)-PXL:2-HBA co-crystal43»: citato senza condizioni ne' numeri, non estratto. Fase transitoria: a 100 °C il raffinamento Rietveld suggerisce «the appearance of a third phase»; non e' una forma caratterizzata e non si estrae come forma.

forme.citazione: Phase I crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna21 non-centrosymmetric space group with the following unit cell parameters: a=30.439(5) Å, b=7.6469(14) Å, c=7.4413(13) Å and V=1732.1(5) Å3.
forme.note: Fase asolvata: «Phase I is an asolvated (±)-PXL1:4-HBA1 racemic compound co-crystal». Unita' asimmetrica: una molecola di PXL e una di 4-HBA. Cristallo misurato a 150 K («under a N2 cryostream at 150K»). Z non scritto; Z_primo = 1 dall'unita' asimmetrica.

forme.citazione: Phase II crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c centrosymmetric space group with the following unit cell parameters: a=22.274(2) Å, b=11.843(1) Å, c=14.439(1) Å, β=97.326(3)°, V=3777.8(6) Å3.

motivi_hb.motivo: supramolecular layers close to the (101) planes
motivi_hb.citazione: Several H-bonds (Table S3) ensure the cohesion of the network in two directions of the space to form supramolecular layers close to the (101) planes directions.

forme.note: Stechiometria degli ospiti non determinata: nella struttura gli atomi leggeri disordinati sono stati assegnati a ossigeno con occupazioni parziali (cavita' di ca. 80 Å3, «2 water molecules approximately or other molecules»); dalla TGA-MS «a possible chemical composition for the phase-II would be (C10H14N4O3)1(C7H6O3)1.xH2O,yCO2 (with x and y < 1)». Composizione dell'ospite variabile col solvente di partenza (isobutanolo: soprattutto acqua e poca CO2; acetone: acqua e CO2 in quantita' simili). Cristallo singolo misurato a 120 K, raccolto da una polvere trattata con CO2: «a single crystal suitable for X-ray diffraction could be collected from a CO2-processed powder and was confirmed later to match with the Phase II PXRD»; non si e' riusciti a crescere Phase II per evaporazione lenta. Gli autori la chiamano «solvated cocrystal (Phase II)» e «could be a solvate in the sense that small molecules would be encased in the voids of the structure, but without any clear identification of the included solvent».

forme.citazione: The tests were performed for commercial racemic PXL (RI phase) and 4-HBA in ethanol, acetone, isobutanol, and ethyl acetate.
forme.note: Composto racemo commerciale (fase RI), «the stable racemic compound (RI form)». Identificato con il «raw (±)-PXL» del Figure 2 (pattern a) per il solo testo dei metodi sulla solubilita'. Le altre forme del PXL puro (RII, cEI, cEII) sono nominate solo per dire che dopo LAG non ci sono, e non sono estratte come forme.

relazioni.citazione: Phase I is the stable form under atmospheric conditions and can be easily prepared by LAG but also occurs during crystallization with CO2 based techniques.
relazioni.relazione_scritta: Phase II is metastable in ambient conditions
relazioni.note: Phase II e' un solvato (CO2, acqua) di Phase I: la stabilita' dipende dall'atmosfera di ospiti, non e' mono/enantiotropia. Gli autori: «This indicates that, in ambient conditions, Phase II is metastable.» e «a metastable phase which evolves towards the stable Phase I fabricated by LAG».

macinazione.liquido: 20 μL of either acetone, ethanol, ethyl acetate and isobutanol
macinazione.testo: two 10 mL zirconia jars; solvent:powder molar ratio 1:3

citazioni: Liquid assisted grinding (LAG) was carried out at room temperature using a Retsch Vibratory Mill MM400 working with two 10 mL zirconia jars containing one 12 mm diameter zirconia ball. Grinding was performed at a frequency of 30 Hz for 30 minutes and experiments involved a 1:1 molar ratio between (±)-PXL and 4-HBA. 20 μL of either acetone, ethanol, ethyl acetate and isobutanol were then added (solvent:powder molar ratio: 1:3).
After grinding, the same solid form was systematically isolated regardless of the solvent used
It can be seen that the initial components are not detected.
This suggests the formation of a (±)-PXL1:4-HBA1 co-crystal that was labelled Phase I.
LAG promotes the crystallization of an orthorhombic Pna21 form (Phase I)
eventi.note: LAG di (±)-PXL e 4-HBA 1:1 con 20 μL di uno fra acetone, etanolo, acetato di etile, isobutanolo: «the same solid form was systematically isolated regardless of the solvent used». I componenti di partenza non si vedono piu' e «the other crystal forms of pure PXL (i.e., the two racemic compounds RI and RII, or the conglomerates cEI and cEII, Figure S1) are not present after LAG». Il pattern mostrato e' quello ottenuto in etanolo (Figure 2c); l'identita' del prodotto con la struttura di Phase I e' quella del cristallo singolo da evaporazione lenta e del profile matching. Temperatura: «room temperature» senza numero.

citazioni: However, despite several attempts (neat grinding or LAG with different experimental parameters or classical solvent evaporation crystallizations from acetone, isobutanol or ethyl acetate) it was not possible to crystallize Phase II in the absence of compressed CO2 in the medium.
The structure of Phase II originates from this inclusion since this phase is never obtained in the absence of CO2.
eventi.note: Negativo: dalla macinazione (a secco o con liquido, con parametri diversi da quelli di E1) della miscela PXL + 4-HBA si ottiene sempre Phase I (E1), mai Phase II; Phase II richiede CO2 compressa. Parametri della macinazione non detti («with different experimental parameters»): condizioni ambigue. Il negativo per l'evaporazione del solvente e' fra le preparazioni (non_ottenuta).

osservazioni.cinetica: completa o quasi in dieci giorni

citazioni: The stability of the CO2- produced powders upon storage at room condition of 20°C was studied by X-Ray diffraction, Raman and Second Harmonic Generation spectroscopies.
The evolution upon storage at 20 °C and atmospheric pressure of the PXRD patterns of selected GAS samples produced from isobutanol, acetone, and ethyl acetate are shown in Figure 13.
This indicates that, in ambient conditions, Phase II is metastable.
The changeover of the powder produced from acetone (A-37) or ethyl acetate (AE-37) is complete or almost complete within ten days.
Figure 13 also shows that the kinetic of the solid-state transformation of Phase II into Phase I depends on the solvent used during the GAS process
eventi.note: Polvere A-37 (GAS da acetone a 37 °C, miscela Phase I + II con 26 % di Phase II alla preparazione, Table 2) conservata a 20 °C e pressione atmosferica: il Phase II passa a Phase I. Table 3 (contenuto di Phase I, acetone): D+3 75 %, D+11 99 %, D+14 100 % (l'articolo dice invece «within ten days»; si tiene la frase, la tabella e' in nota). Via 'aria' per la regola sui solvati lasciati all'aria: il testo attribuisce la trasformazione alla perdita degli ospiti («Their departure will certainly lead to a collapse of the structure with a return back to the asolvated Phase I») e discute lo scambio con l'acqua dell'aria, ma non dice il recipiente di conservazione. Cinetica: «the higher the proportion of stable phase, the faster the transition» (la polvere A-37 parte con 74 % di Phase I).
eventi.pretrattamento: polvere A-37 da GAS in acetone a 37 °C (miscela Phase I + II, 26 % Phase II)

The evolution upon storage at 20 °C and atmospheric pressure of the PXRD patterns of selected GAS samples produced from isobutanol, acetone, and ethyl acetate are shown in Figure 13.
In contrast, after 12 days of storage, the isobutanol sample (IB-40) is still pure at 99% in Phase II (Table 3).
In the case of a pure metastable II powder, such as sample IB-40, the conversion starts significantly later, which means that the metastable phase can be stored for longer.

La conversione parte molto piu' tardi che nei campioni misti (E3, E4) e finisce entro D+28 (E6). Contraddice la frase generale «the three powders transformed within a few days into Phase I». Via 'aria' come in E3.

while the final phase is always Phase I regardless the solvent used to generate the powder, the transition rate to achieve the complete conversion depends on it.
eventi.note: Il campione IB-40 (Phase II pura) arriva al 100 % di Phase I a D+28 (Table 3, colonna dell'isobutanolo: la riga «D+14 100 % D+28 100 %» ha D+14 nella colonna dell'acetone e D+28 in quella dell'isobutanolo); a D+12 era ancora 99 % Phase II (E5). citazioni: A powdered (±)-PXL1:4-HBA1 co-crystal sample consisting of pure Phase II was prepared by the SEDS methods and stored under CO2 atmosphere in 2 mL glass vial.
In these conditions, no transformation of Phase II into Phase I was detected by SHG within the timeframe of the experiment
The stability of the CO2- produced powders upon storage at room condition of 20°C was studied by X-Ray diffraction, Raman and Second Harmonic Generation spectroscopies.
eventi.note: Negativo: Phase II pura (da SEDS) conservata sotto atmosfera di CO2 in una vial di vetro da 2 mL non si trasforma in Phase I entro la durata dell'esperimento (durata non detta); «this is likely due to high vapor pressure of CO2 inside the vial that delays the departure of the insertion compounds from the inclusion sites of Phase II». La T di 20 °C non e' ripetuta nella frase: vale quella della sezione («storage at room condition of 20°C»), per questo non e' messa in condizioni. osservazioni.cinetica: sigmoidale: onset a ca. 6 giorni, plateau a ca. 20 giorni

citazioni: Then, the vial was opened and the powder was transferred into two separate vials, one was left open and the other was closed, and Figure 14 shows the evolution of the SHG signal of the powder of these two samples over time at 20 °C.
In both cases, a typical sigmoidal curve was observed: the onset of the transformation into Phase I was detected after ca. 6 days and a plateau was reached after ca. 20 days.
It is however interesting to note that the rate of apparition of Phase I after the onset of transition is larger for the opened sample than for the closed sample.
This confirms that the CO2 content in the atmosphere in equilibrium with the solid phase has a stabilizing effect on Phase II.
Figure 14. Evolution of the SHG signal measured upon storing Phase II at 20 °C inside (blue) closed or (red) open vial.
eventi.note: Phase II pura (da SEDS), tolta dalla CO2 e lasciata in vial APERTA a 20 °C: il segnale SHG (assente per la fase centrosimmetrica Phase II, presente per Phase I) compare dopo ca. 6 giorni (onset) e raggiunge il plateau dopo ca. 20 giorni. Velocita' di comparsa di Phase I dopo l'onset maggiore che nella vial chiusa (E9). La frase di sintesi dice «within ca. 2 weeks»: si tengono i valori specifici (onset 6 giorni, plateau 20 giorni).
eventi.pretrattamento: Phase II pura da SEDS, conservata sotto CO2 in vial chiusa, poi vial aperta

citazioni: In situ Raman spectroscopy was also applied to pure Phase II SEDS-powder, monitoring over 5 days the evolution of some selected wavenumbers.
As shown in Figure 15, the structural reorganization into Phase I took thus about 4 days under the analysis conditions (air, darkness, Raman laser beam).
In situ Raman analysis highlighted that temperature, provided by the laser beam in that analysis, may accelerated the conversion.
eventi.note: Phase II pura (da SEDS) analizzata in situ con Raman per 5 giorni all'aria, al buio e sotto il laser: il riarrangiamento in Phase I richiede ca. 4 giorni. Marcatore: calo del picco a 1674 cm-1 (stiramento C=O). Gli autori avvertono che il riscaldamento dovuto al laser puo' avere accelerato la conversione. La didascalia della Fig. 15 scrive «Phase I -> Phase II» ma il testo e i dati sono II -> I.

citazioni: The same powder, unanalyzed and stored in a closed vial, remained unchanged for 96 hours
In situ Raman spectroscopy was also applied to pure Phase II SEDS-powder, monitoring over 5 days the evolution of some selected wavenumbers.
eventi.note: Negativo: la stessa polvere di E10, non analizzata e conservata in vial chiusa, resta invariata per 96 ore («consistent with storage results for GAS-sample»). La frase non nomina Phase I come forma attesa: e' quella dell'esperimento Raman precedente (E10). Temperatura non detta.

citazioni: A thermogravimetric analysis coupled with mass spectrometry was performed using a TGA Setaram TGA2400 combined with a Pfeiffer Thermostar mass spectrometer. The measurements were carried out in argon atmosphere in the range 20 – 140°C using a heating rate of 10 °C/min.
Two samples were studied by TGA-MS, both containing Phase II but obtained from two solvents: isobutanol (pure Phase II, Figure 12a) and acetone (Figure 12b).

As shown by TGA on Figure 12, both samples exhibited a mass loss of 3.4% when temperature increased from 40 to 110°C; a unique mass loss event was detected for the powder obtained from isobutanol, while a two-step behavior was clearly observed for the acetone processed sample with a first loss of 1.1% between 40 and 80°C and a much more abrupt mass loss above 80°C.
While the inclusion component was essentially water for the isobutanol processed sample, the acetone processed sample contained significant quantities of CO2.
(no trace of isobutanol was detected)
eventi.note: TGA-MS di Phase II pura da GAS in isobutanolo: un solo evento di perdita di massa del 3.4 % fra 40 e 110 °C; ospite soprattutto acqua e, intorno alla stessa T, molta meno CO2 («a much smaller amount of CO2 was released around the same temperature»); nessuna traccia di isobutanolo. Prodotto non caratterizzato nella TGA (a: ignota): gli autori dicono che la partenza degli ospiti porta al «collapse of the structure with a return back to the asolvated Phase I», ma non lo mostrano in questo esperimento. Metodi e risultati non coincidono sull'intervallo («20 – 140°C» contro «25-130°C» e «from 40 to 110°C»): si riporta quello dei risultati per il 3.4 %. Etichetta del campione non detta (Figure 12a).

citazioni: A thermogravimetric analysis coupled with mass spectrometry was performed using a TGA Setaram TGA2400 combined with a Pfeiffer Thermostar mass spectrometer. The measurements were carried out in argon atmosphere in the range 20 – 140°C using a heating rate of 10 °C/min.
Two samples were studied by TGA-MS, both containing Phase II but obtained from two solvents: isobutanol (pure Phase II, Figure 12a) and acetone (Figure 12b).
Since the acetone sample was a mixture of phases rich in Phase II, it was checked by TGA that Phase I did not show any mass loss under heating (Figure S5).

As shown by TGA on Figure 12, both samples exhibited a mass loss of 3.4% when temperature increased from 40 to 110°C; a unique mass loss event was detected for the powder obtained from isobutanol, while a two-step behavior was clearly observed for the acetone processed sample with a first loss of 1.1% between 40 and 80°C and a much more abrupt mass loss above 80°C.

According to the MS results, these two steps were correlated to: (i) the removal of water before 80 °C and (ii) to the removal of significant amount of CO2 and of a smaller amount of water and acetone when temperature increased above 80°C (Figure 12b).
eventi.note: TGA-MS della polvere da GAS in acetone (miscela Phase I + II ricca di Phase II): perdita totale 3.4 % fra 40 e 110 °C in due passi, il primo dell'1.1 % fra 40 e 80 °C (acqua) e un secondo, piu' brusco, sopra 80 °C (molta CO2, un po' di acqua e di acetone). La perdita e' attribuita a Phase II perche' Phase I non perde massa (E19). Il secondo passo non ha un numero suo. Prodotto non caratterizzato (a: ignota). Conclusione degli autori: due tipi di siti per gli ospiti; «the first one seems playing an important role in the scaffold of the Phase II structure and is occupied by water molecules, the second site can be occupied by other solvent molecules»; «CO2 is the last molecule extracted from the structure».
eventi.pretrattamento: polvere da GAS in acetone, miscela di Phase I e Phase II (ricca di Phase II)

citazioni: Samples of around 10 mg were heated in a pierced aluminum crucible at 10°C/min from -25°C to 200°C under 50 mL/min N2 purge.

The DSC curve obtained upon heating Phase II (obtained by SEDS) at 10°C/min under N2 atmosphere, exhibits multiple thermal events between 20 and 200 °C (Figure 16). A first very broad endothermic transformation (ΔH = 82.9 J.g-1) associated with a mass loss (3.2%) was detected from 20 to 97 °C.
Thus, upon heating Phase II, desolvation of the structure occurs and the desolvated phase is expected to recrystallize the stable Phase I.
Figure 16. DSC of the SEDS sample produced from acetone solution as pure Phase II cocrystals
eventi.note: DSC-TG di Phase II pura (SEDS da acetone): primo evento endotermico molto largo (ΔH = 82.9 J.g-1) con perdita di massa del 3.2 % fra 20 e 97 °C, «in good agreement with the thermal behavior observed for Phase II prepared by GAS (Figure 12)». Prodotto non caratterizzato nel DSC (a: ignota): «the desolvated phase is expected to recrystallize the stable Phase I». Il segnale DSC fra 100 e 135 °C e' «difficult to interpret but is likely due to a succession of several recrystallization and melting events, eventually leading to Phase I»: e' la stessa trasformazione II -> I vista con la VT-PXRD (E16), non un evento nuovo. Discordanza fra tecniche: il DSC mette la disidratazione fra 20 e 97 °C, la VT-PXRD a 50 °C (passi di 2 ore, aria ambiente) non vede «any effect of desolvation».
eventi.pretrattamento: Phase II pura da SEDS in acetone

citazioni: Temperature resolved PXRD analyses were thus carried out to confirm this interpretation. A sample consisting of pure Phase II (IB-41, prepared by GAS) was used, each temperature step required 2 hours of analysis. The atmosphere of the sample was not regulated (ambient conditions).
Figure 17 confirms that, at 25°C, only pure Phase II is detected. At 50 °C, no effect of desolvation was observed and only the pattern of Phase II was collected.
eventi.note: Negativo: VT-PXRD di Phase II pura (IB-41, GAS), a 50 °C nessun effetto di desolvatazione e solo il pattern di Phase II (passo di 2 ore, atmosfera non regolata). Partenza a 25 °C: solo Phase II. La frase non nomina la forma attesa (a: ignota). Il DSC (E14) vede invece perdita di massa gia' fra 20 e 97 °C.
eventi.pretrattamento: Phase II pura IB-41 da GAS in isobutanolo

citazioni: Temperature resolved PXRD analyses were thus carried out to confirm this interpretation. A sample consisting of pure Phase II (IB-41, prepared by GAS) was used, each temperature step required 2 hours of analysis. The atmosphere of the sample was not regulated (ambient conditions).

Figure 17 confirms that, at 25°C, only pure Phase II is detected. At 50 °C, no effect of desolvation was observed and only the pattern of Phase II was collected. When the temperature reaches 100°C, the crystallinity of the material changes: peaks at 8.02°, 8.53°, 10.12°, 10.77°, and 12.13° (2θ) shift or disappear completely while specific peaks of Phase I appear. These results are in rather good agreement with the DSC data. At 130 °C, only the pattern of Phase I is collected.
Thus, upon heating Phase II, desolvation of the structure occurs and the desolvated phase is expected to recrystallize the stable Phase I.

The DSC signal in the 100 – 135 °C range is difficult to interpret but is likely due to a succession of several recrystallization and melting events, eventually leading to Phase I, since its melting was detected at 150 °C (see Figure S7 for DSC of pure Phase I).
The refinement did not fully explain the pattern, suggesting the appearance of a third phase (Figure S8).
In agreement with the DSC thermogram, it is possible that Phase II converts into one or several transient phases before transforming into Phase I.
Figure 17. Evolution of PXRD patterns of the GAS pure Phase II sample (IB-41) upon heat treatment, while heating at (a) 25°C, (b) 50°C, (c) 100°C, (d) 130°C, and cooling at (e) 75°C, (f) 25°C.
eventi.note: VT-PXRD di Phase II pura (IB-41, GAS): a 25 e 50 °C solo Phase II; a 100 °C i picchi di Phase II si spostano o spariscono e compaiono picchi specifici di Phase I (prima T con la forma nuova: valore 100, min = 50 ultima T senza cambio); a 130 °C solo Phase I. A 100 °C il raffinamento non spiega tutto il pattern: «the appearance of a third phase»; gli autori ipotizzano «one or several transient phases» prima di Phase I (non estratta come forma). Il DSC (100-135 °C: «a succession of several recrystallization and melting events, eventually leading to Phase I») e' la stessa trasformazione con un'altra tecnica e non fa un evento nuovo. La velocita' di riscaldamento non e' detta (passi di 2 ore).
eventi.pretrattamento: Phase II pura IB-41 da GAS in isobutanolo

citazioni: Upon cooling to 75°C and 25°C, the powder retains its stable lattice.
Figure 17. Evolution of PXRD patterns of the GAS pure Phase II sample (IB-41) upon heat treatment, while heating at (a) 25°C, (b) 50°C, (c) 100°C, (d) 130°C, and cooling at (e) 75°C, (f) 25°C.
eventi.note: Dopo il riscaldamento a 130 °C (solo Phase I) il raffreddamento a 75 e poi a 25 °C non cambia niente: «the powder retains its stable lattice». Non c'e' ritorno a Phase II. La frase non nomina la forma attesa (a: ignota); 'da' e' Phase I perche' il campione a 130 °C e' Phase I (E16).

citazioni: since its melting was detected at 150 °C (see Figure S7 for DSC of pure Phase I)
eventi.note: Fusione di Phase I pura osservata in DSC a 150 °C (Figure S7, nel supplementare); tipo di temperatura (onset/picco) non detto. Condizioni DSC di questo campione non dette (il metodo generale e' 10 °C/min da -25 a 200 °C, ma e' scritto per i cocristalli trattati con CO2).

citazioni: Since the acetone sample was a mixture of phases rich in Phase II, it was checked by TGA that Phase I did not show any mass loss under heating (Figure S5).
eventi.note: Negativo: la TGA di Phase I (asolvata) non mostra perdita di massa riscaldando (Figure S5, nel supplementare). Intervallo e velocita' di questa prova non detti (non si assume quello del metodo TGA-MS).

citazioni: Phase I is the stable form under atmospheric conditions and can be easily prepared by LAG but also occurs during crystallization with CO2 based techniques.
It is shown that though both methods produce a racemic compound (±)-PXL1:4-HBA1 cocrystal, LAG promotes the crystallization of an orthorhombic Pna21 form (Phase I)
preparazioni.note: Phase I da LAG: e' l'evento E1.

citazioni: Some attempts were made to prepare single crystals suitable for diffraction experiments by slow evaporation of (±)-PXL:4-HBA equimolar saturated solutions made with various solvents.
We succeeded in isolating a single crystal for Phase I
preparazioni.note: Cristallo singolo di Phase I per SCXRD, da evaporazione lenta di soluzioni sature equimolari in «various solvents» (non nominati).

citazioni: Then, a slight increase of temperature from 37°C to 40°C was sufficient to obtain pure cocrystals of Phase II in isobutanol.
In this GAS set-up, the CO2 dispersed directly into the solution through the blades of a Rushton turbine whose rotation was set at 300 rpm until reaching the desired pressure of 10 MPa.

Comparison of experiments IB-37 and IB-40 permits to highlight a similar positive effect of temperature on the crystallization of Phase II in isobutanol from which the highest structural purity could be achieved (Figure 9).
preparazioni.note: GAS (CO2 antisolvente) da isobutanolo con T iniziale di 40 °C (campione IB-40, Table 2: Ti-Tf 40-40, Pp 8.2 MPa, resa 58 %): Phase II pura (100 %). Anche IB-41 (T iniziale 41 °C, Pp > 8.5 MPa) da' Phase II pura. 10 MPa e' la pressione finale del metodo GAS, non quella di precipitazione.

citazioni: We first focus on samples A-37, AE-37 and IB-37 (Table 2): it permits to compare cocrystallization attempts from acetone, ethyl acetate and isobutanol at 37°C.
It shows that, at 37 °C and regardless of the solvent, the three samples consist of a mixture of phases I and II with no residual traces of (±)-PXL and 4-HBA.
At 37°C, trials performed in isobutanol yielded powders with significantly higher proportions of Phase II than trials performed in acetone (41% vs 26%).
preparazioni.note: GAS a 37 °C (T iniziale): miscele di Phase I e II in tutti e tre i solventi. Phase II (Rietveld, Table 2): acetone A-37 26 %, acetato di etile AE-37 51 %, isobutanolo IB-37 41 %.

citazioni: For acetone-based recrystallizations, the proportion of Phase II increased from 12% to 91% when the working temperature was increased from 25 to 51°C.
However, even at the highest temperature tested (51°C), the powder produced still contained 9% of Phase I, therefore, none of the investigated conditions in acetone using GAS produced pure Phase II.
preparazioni.note: GAS da acetone a T iniziale crescente: Phase II 12 % (A-25), 26 % (A-37), 70 % (A-42), 91 % (A-51), sempre in miscela con Phase I (Table 2). Mai Phase II pura in acetone con il GAS.

citazioni: Pressure and temperature conditions for the test performed in acetone were 12 MPa and 50°C respectively.
Figure 11 confirms that pure Phase II is also obtained by the SEDS methods since no trace of Phase I was detected.
Compressed CO2 was first introduced through the outer channel of the nozzle at a flow rate of 30 g/min into the vessel heated at 50°C and kept at 12 MPa.
preparazioni.note: SEDS (ugello coassiale, CO2 + soluzione): Phase II pura da acetone, mentre col GAS in acetone non si ottiene pura. Eseguito da un altro gruppo (Sanofi).

citazioni: When the PXL:4HBA ratio was changed for 1:2 or 1:0.5 instead of 1:1, extra peaks appeared in the diffractograms according to the component in excess, but Phase II was still the only produced cocrystal lattice.
preparazioni.note: SEDS con rapporto PXL:4-HBA diverso da 1:1: compaiono picchi del componente in eccesso, ma il cocristallo prodotto resta Phase II. Il solvente della prova non e' ripetuto nella frase (il test SEDS descritto e' in acetone).

citazioni: When the coaxial nozzle was replaced by separate entrances for CO2 and solution, the obtained powder was a mixture of Phases I and II, highlighting the fact that mixing conditions influence the produced cocrystal form
preparazioni.note: SEDS senza ugello coassiale (ingressi separati per CO2 e soluzione): miscela di Phase I e II invece di Phase II pura.

citazioni: However, despite several attempts (neat grinding or LAG with different experimental parameters or classical solvent evaporation crystallizations from acetone, isobutanol or ethyl acetate) it was not possible to crystallize Phase II in the absence of compressed CO2 in the medium.

preparazioni.note: Phase II non si ottiene per evaporazione classica del solvente (ne' come polvere, ne' come cristallo singolo per la SCXRD). La macinazione e' l'evento negativo E2.

citazioni: A preliminary test of cocrystallization of (±)-PXL and salicylic acid (SA) by GAS failed, in that only PXL homocrystals were produced.
preparazioni.note: Cocristallo (±)-PXL + acido salicilico (SA) non ottenuto col GAS: solo omocristalli di PXL. E' per questo che si e' scelto il 4-HBA. Forma del PXL ottenuta non detta.

citazioni: recrystallisation of (±)-PXL alone from an acetone solution systematically led to the crystallization of the stable racemic compound (RI form), i.e. no new CO2-specific form was produced.
preparazioni.note: Ricristallizzazione del solo (±)-PXL da acetone: sempre la forma stabile RI, nessuna forma specifica della CO2. Il metodo non e' detto (nel contesto dei processi con CO2).

citazioni: Racemic proxyphylline, (±)-3,7-dihydro-7-(2-hydroxypropyl)-1,3-dimethyl-1H-purine-2,6-dione, 98%, (±)-PXL) and 4-hydroxybenzoic acid (99%, 4-HBA) were supplied from TCI EUROPE (Belgium).
The tests were performed for commercial racemic PXL (RI phase) and 4-HBA in ethanol, acetone, isobutanol, and ethyl acetate.
